scope: Read-only English homepage semantics audit; proposed copy only

issues.why: The closing headline states that tomorrow already has weather attached without a location or availability qualification. Forecast retrieval can yield no hours; a future calendar date does not establish weather coverage. The CTA lead only discusses accounts, so it does not qualify the weather promise.

issues.before: Seven columns, each headed by its own high, low and condition. Rotate to landscape for the full spread. Grab an event and slide it to another day.
issues.proposed: Compare the week’s appointments with available daily weather. Rotate to landscape for a wider view. Move editable events to another day, and check which occurrences to change for a repeating event.
issues.why: Each headed by its own high, low and condition makes forecast presence unconditional; grab an event omits the actual read-only guard and repeating-event choice. The general showcase lead is not rendered, so its availability qualification cannot help this visible panel. The proposal keeps the supported capabilities without promising weather for every column.

issues.proposed: Drag it. Resize it. Review it.
issues.why: Done compresses a gesture into completed editing even though recurrence selection, permission checks and reviewing the saved result remain relevant. The corrected adjacent body already explains these; the proposed headline makes the heading consistent rather than introducing another workflow. This is a heading/body consistency issue, not evidence that gestures are absent.

Native list search is implemented. Here is merely ambiguous on a website whose tour shows screenshots and navigational controls, not a working event-search interface. Keep the capability and clarify its location; do not label the existing feature unsupported.

Nothing to decode is subjective ease-of-use copy, not a technical capability claim. Dates and times is an optional plainer description of the agenda. There is no demonstrated product defect here and no need to invent a decoding requirement.

The one-tap action really can open a draft, and the adjacent body already says to review before saving. Naming that result in the badge removes a possible completed-plan reading without declaring the one-tap entry point false.

consumer_findings.finding: Defined in the locale object but not referenced by the showcase template. The prior corrected lead therefore does not qualify visible tour panels. No template change proposed in this audit.
steps() merges localized panels with fixed screenshots. Bullets are plain text. Clicking screenshots or rail buttons navigates tour steps.

Sample metric captions are fallback data. metrics uses snapshot captions when a matching metric exists; the no-snapshot hint explicitly says sample data, not live weather. Do not treat these sample captions as promises about the app or the visitor’s current weather.

retained.reason: Already distinguish local calendars without an account from connections/sharing that may need sign-in.
Already qualify selected calendars, provider permissions and successful synchronization; do not restore a universal two-way or instantaneous promise.
Already distinguish website Open-Meteo from app WeatherKit, finite returned dates/hours, selected place and event drafts.
These are screenshot descriptions, not independently established runtime guarantees. No screenshot visual review performed here; do not infer false product claims solely from their wording.

Three accounts is shorthand alongside explicit provider names and Premium qualification, not an explicit assertion that sign-in is compulsory or a tested account maximum. No new account correction justified by this review.

limits: Static source and existing evidence review only; no release/runtime certification.
